label: PR Iteration Loop
description: Solve a problem through verified iterations on one long-running draft pull request
tips: Select one bounded checkpoint per run and preserve accepted progress on one deterministic branch and draft pull request
Persist iteration history, evidence, lessons, and blockers in repo-memory so later runs do not repeat failed approaches
Accept an iteration only when it improves the defined metric or completion contract and passes verification
Pause after bounded retries or a repeated failure signature instead of retrying indefinitely
